svg.title: Research lines on a timeline
svg.desc: A timeline with one row per research line for the 12 largest lines, native-geometric-sept, m1-discrete-attention, harness-governance, m2-exact-memory, geometric-stack-pretraining, r4g1-transformerless, m4-serving, m1-float-rung0, m3-durable-memory, compute-ops, eval-panels, geometric-intelligence-aug. Each dot is one dated catalog record on its date: blue circles are positive results, vermilion diamonds negative results, hollow grey circles everything else. Notice where each line starts and ends and where records pile up.
svg.text: The 12 largest research lines by record count, one dot per dated record, 21 Jul to 19 Oct.
anything else: plans, tooling, process, review, inconclusive and so on
Records of one line on one day stack in a small grid; a very busy day overlaps. The number at the left of each lane is the line's record count.
Not shown: 8 smaller lines (35 records), and 115 undated records of the lines above. Catalog: 1173 records, 122 without a date.
Lines shown hold 1138 of the catalog's 1173 records.
